repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
repos.summary_en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

repos.description:  This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Mac 是一个精选 macOS 优质软件的资源库，涵盖开发工具、设计软件、效率应用等多个类别。项目规模庞大，支持多语言（含中文、韩文），并提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包形式发布。包含开源、免费、App Store 应用等标签分类，鼓励用户贡献与反馈。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Mac is a curated collection of premium macOS software across categories like development tools, design apps, and productivity utilities. It features a vast scale, multilingual support (including Chinese and Korean), and is available via Docker and npm. The list categorizes apps by open-source, freeware, and App Store status, encouraging community contributions.

repos.description: 🐹 Keep your Mac clean, light, and running like new. Fast open-source CLI, plus a native Mac app.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: A full-featured download manager.
repos.summary_zh: Motrix 是一款现代化全功能下载管理器，支持 HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent 及磁力链接。v2 基于 Electron+React+TypeScript 重构，采用 MDXP 协议实现浏览器扩展与 CLI 远程控制，支持 Docker 无头服务器部署，适用于桌面与 NAS/家庭服务器场景。
repos.summary_en: Motrix is a modern, full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet links. v2 is rebuilt with Electron, React, and TypeScript, using the MDXP protocol for browser extensions and CLI remote control. It supports Docker headless deployment, ideal for desktop and NAS/home server scenarios.

repos.description: 🚀 Awesome list of open source applications for macOS. https://t.me/s/opensourcemacosapps
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是 macOS 开源应用精选列表，收录 689 款高质量开源应用，涵盖音频、开发、图形、生产力等 49 个类别。以 Swift 为主力语言，支持跨平台与原生应用，旨在帮助用户发现优质免费工具并鼓励社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 689 open source macOS applications across 49 categories, including audio, development, graphics, and productivity. Primarily written in Swift, it features both native and cross-platform apps to help users discover free tools and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源的跨平台屏幕录制与编辑工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它无需后期剪辑即可生成专业级演示视频，内置自动缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头气泡叠加、时间轴编辑及扩展市场等功能，专为教程、产品演示等场景优化，显著提升录制效率与视觉表现。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It enables polished screen recordings without post-editing by offering auto-zooms, cursor enhancements, dynamic webcam overlays, timeline editing, and a community extension marketplace—ideal for demos, walkthroughs, and product videos.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 ShadowsocksX 的下一代 macOS 客户端，采用 Swift 重写 GUI 并集成 shadowsocks-libev 的 ss-local 组件。支持 SIP003 插件、AEAD 加密、PAC 自动更新及二维码分享服务器配置，提供手动代理模式以兼容其他应用。通过 launchd 后台运行 ss-local，提升稳定性并简化依赖管理。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, rebuilt with Swift and integrated with ss-local from shadowsocks-libev. It supports SIP003 plugins, AEAD ciphers, PAC auto-updates, QR code sharing, and manual proxy mode. By running ss-local as a background service via launchd, it improves stability and simplifies dependency management.

repos.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows. Understand How to write meeting minutes
repos.summary_zh: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 构建的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。它利用本地 AI 模型（如 Ollama）实现 4 倍速的实时转录、说话人分离及会议摘要，所有数据均在本地处理，无需云端，完美契合企业对数据主权与合规性的严苛要求。
repos.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant built on Rust for macOS and Windows. Leveraging local AI models like Ollama, it delivers 4x faster real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization with 100% local processing, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance without cloud dependency.

repos.description: A cross-platform launcher that simply works
repos.summary_zh: Wox 是一款跨平台启动器，提供快速搜索应用、文件、文件夹及AI聊天功能，支持MCP集成。通过插件系统和主题扩展，用户可用JavaScript或Python开发自定义功能。软件为单文件免安装，兼容Windows/macOS/Linux，快捷键操作高效便捷，是Alfred和Raycast的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Wox is a cross-platform launcher offering fast search for apps, files, and folders, plus AI chat with MCP support. It features a plugin system (JavaScript/Python) and themes, runs as a single executable without installation, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. Designed as an open-source alternative to Alfred and Raycast, it emphasizes simplicity and extensibility.

repos.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
repos.summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具箱，旨在替代多个付费系统工具。它集成了应用独立音量调节、系统资源监控、窗口切换、剪贴板历史、文件暂存架及应用卸载等十余项功能。所有功能均本地运行，无需账户或订阅，通过单一图标即可访问，极大提升了 Mac 用户的操作效率。
repos.summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit designed to replace a stack of paid utilities. It integrates over a dozen features including per-app volume mixing, system monitoring, window switching, clipboard history, and app uninstallation. Running entirely locally with no accounts or subscriptions, it consolidates multiple tools into a single, efficient menu bar icon.

repos.description: 🐱 BongoCat — A cross-platform interactive desktop pet that brings fun to your desktop!
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

repos.description: 🐱 🧸跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，支持Windows、macOS和Linux。猫咪会在桌面上自由行走、互动，为桌面增添趣味与陪伴感。项目正从Tauri迁移至C/C++、SDL3和OpenGL的原生实现，轻量高效，适合个性化桌面装饰与解压场景。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet app supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The cat wanders and interacts on your desktop, adding fun and companionship. Migrating from Tauri to a native C/C++ + SDL3 + OpenGL implementation for better performance, ideal for desktop personalization and stress relief.

repos.description: A plugin for Mac WeChat
repos.summary_zh: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac 是一款专为 macOS 设计的微信插件，支持多开、免认证登录、消息撤回同步、自定义回复及AI自动回复等功能。集成迷离/黑夜/上帝/少女等主题皮肤，适配微信3.1.2+，兼容企业微信与简版助手，提供跨平台消息转发与小程序详情展示，是Objective-C生态中广受欢迎的自动化工具之一。
repos.summary_en: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac is a macOS plugin for WeChat that enables multi-account login, message recall sync, custom replies, and AI auto-reply. It supports themes like Mysterious/Dark/God/Daughter modes, integrates with WeChat 3.1.2+, and offers features like message forwarding, mini-program details, and cross-device notifications. A popular Objective-C project with enterprise and lightweight versions.

repos.description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
repos.summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的智能跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它兼容任意 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），支持本地运行 Ollama 等模型，无需账户即可使用。核心特性包括：持久化 SSH 会话、内嵌远程文件编辑器、富文本预览（Markdown/图片/PDF）、AI 助手实时分析终端输出并操作文件，以及强大的 `wsh` CLI 工具实现工作区管理与跨会话数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Wave Terminal is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports any AI model via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models like Ollama/LM Studio. Key features include durable SSH sessions with auto-reconnect, built-in remote file editor, rich file previews (markdown, images, PDFs), context-aware Wave AI assistant that analyzes terminal output and performs file operations, and a powerful `wsh` CLI system for workspace management and cross-session data sync.

repos.description: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.
repos.summary_zh: CodexBar 是一款 macOS 14+ 菜单栏应用，实时显示 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 等主流 AI 服务的令牌/额度使用情况（会话+周额度），支持多提供商独立或合并显示，无需登录即可查看窗口重置时间，提供本地成本扫描与状态监控功能。
repos.summary_en: CodexBar is a tiny macOS 14+ menu bar app that displays token/credit usage (session + weekly) for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and other AI providers without requiring login. It supports per-provider toggles, merge icons mode, local cost scanning, and real-time reset countdowns via a compact two-bar meter icon.

repos.description: Lightweight clipboard manager for macOS
repos.summary_zh: Maccy 是一款轻量级 macOS 剪贴板管理器，支持历史记录保存、快速搜索与检索，提供键盘优先操作体验。具备原生界面、隐私安全、开源免费等特性，支持快捷键复制/粘贴、忽略特定应用、自定义过滤规则等高级功能，适用于高效文本管理与重复内容复用场景。
repos.summary_en: Maccy is a lightweight clipboard manager for macOS that preserves copy history with fast search and retrieval. It emphasizes keyboard-first interaction, native UI, privacy, and open-source design. Features include smart filtering, hotkey-based actions, and customizable ignore rules for enhanced productivity.

repos.description: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
repos.summary_zh: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
repos.summary_en: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

repos.description: 收集&推荐优秀的 Apps/硬件/技巧/周边等
repos.summary_zh: Best App 是一个精选优质应用、硬件及生活技巧的推荐项目，涵盖 macOS、iOS、Android 等平台。聚焦付费与免费精品应用，提供详细功能介绍与横向测评，帮助用户高效选择提升效率与幸福感的工具。项目强调客观推荐，拒绝广告与捐赠，倡导有章可循的产品选择。
repos.summary_en: Best App is a curated collection of excellent apps, hardware, and life-enhancing tips across macOS, iOS, and Android. It features detailed reviews and comparisons of premium and free apps, helping users make informed choices for productivity and lifestyle improvement. The project maintains objectivity, avoids ads, and encourages community contributions via Star or Pull Request.

repos.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
repos.summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具集，以单一图标整合音量混音、系统监控、窗口管理、剪贴板历史、文本片段等多项实用功能。模块化设计支持按需安装卸载，零账户、零遥测、零订阅，专为用户隐私和性能效率而构建。
repos.summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume mixing, system monitoring, window management, clipboard history, and more into a single lightweight icon. Fully modular, privacy-first with zero telemetry or subscriptions, and requires macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.

repos.description: 微信小助手
repos.summary_zh: WeChatPlugin-MacOS 是一款 macOS 平台的微信小助手工具，旨在提升用户工作效率。它通过自动化消息处理、快捷回复、群管理等功能，简化日常沟通流程，支持多账号管理，适用于需要高效处理微信消息的 macOS 用户。
repos.summary_en: WeChatPlugin-MacOS is a macOS assistant tool for WeChat, designed to enhance productivity. It automates message handling, enables quick replies, and supports group management, streamlining daily communication. Ideal for macOS users managing multiple WeChat accounts efficiently.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: Electronic WeChat 是一款基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，专为 macOS 和 Linux 设计。它复刻了网页版微信的所有功能，包括消息撤回拦截、表情包支持、拖拽发送图片等，并优化了原生应用体验。项目已停止维护，但作为 Electron 桌面应用开发的优秀范例仍具参考价值。
repos.summary_en: Electronic WeChat is an Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, replicating all Web WeChat features including message recall blocking and sticker support. It offers native-like experience with optimizations like direct URL access and drag-and-drop file sharing. Though discontinued, it serves as an excellent reference for Electron desktop app development.

repos.description: A command-line tool for tweaking WeChat - 首款微信 macOS 客户端撤回拦截与多开 🔨
repos.summary_zh: WeChatTweak 是一款专为 macOS 设计的命令行工具，支持微信客户端撤回消息拦截、阻止自动更新及多开功能，通过二进制补丁技术实现原生应用增强，显著提升微信使用灵活性与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: WeChatTweak is a command-line tool for macOS that enables WeChat enhancements including message recall blocking, auto-update prevention, and multi-instance support via binary patching, offering advanced customization for native app workflows.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，支持 macOS 和 Linux，提供现代化界面和完整 Web 微信功能，包括消息撤回拦截、贴图支持、文件拖拽发送等。项目已停止维护，作为技术存档供学习参考。
repos.summary_en: An Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, featuring modern UI, full Web WeChat functionality, message recall blocking, sticker support, and drag-and-drop file sharing. The project is archived and no longer actively maintained.

repos.description: :metal: A collection of Alfred 3 and 4 workflows that will rock your world
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列 Alfred 3/4 工作流工具，涵盖系统休眠控制、浏览器兼容性查询、色彩格式转换、开发文档检索、域名搜索及表情符号查找等实用功能，通过快捷键快速调用，显著提升 macOS 开发者和效率用户的日常操作体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a curated collection of Alfred 3/4 workflows for macOS, including system sleep control, browser compatibility checks, color format conversion, developer documentation search, domain lookup, and emoji search, all accessible via keyboard shortcuts to boost productivity.

repos.description: The open source menu bar manager
repos.summary_zh: Thaw 是一款专为 macOS 设计的菜单栏管理工具，支持 macOS 26+。它提供直观的界面帮助用户整理、隐藏和管理菜单栏图标，提升桌面整洁度与工作效率。项目已通过 OpenSSF 安全认证，支持 20 种语言，拥有活跃的 Discord 社区。
repos.summary_en: Thaw is a menu bar manager for macOS, supporting macOS 26+. It helps users organize, hide, and manage menu bar icons with an intuitive interface, improving desktop cleanliness and productivity. The project has achieved OpenSSF security certification, supports 20 languages, and maintains an active Discord community.

repos.description: Command-line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and macOS apps on the App Store, and download .ipa or macOS .pkg app packages.
repos.summary_zh: ipatool 是一款跨平台命令行工具，支持从 App Store 搜索并下载 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用的 IPA 包。提供认证、搜索、授权获取、版本管理等核心功能，适用于开发者自动化部署、企业级应用分发及批量下载场景。
repos.summary_en: ipatool is a cross-platform command-line tool for searching and downloading iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS app packages (IPA) from the App Store. It supports authentication, search, license acquisition, and version management, ideal for developer workflows, enterprise distribution, and batch app management.

repos.description: [deprecated in favor of https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/] React Native for macOS is an experimental fork for writing desktop apps using Cocoa
repos.summary_zh: React Native macOS 是一个实验性分支，允许使用 React Native 和 Cocoa 构建 macOS 桌面应用。该项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至微软官方支持的 React Native Windows 或利用 Catalyst 技术运行。
repos.summary_en: React Native for macOS was an experimental fork enabling desktop app development using React Native and Cocoa. The project is now deprecated and no longer maintained, with Microsoft's React Native Windows recommended as the successor.

repos.description: Mac Mouse Fix - Make Your $10 Mouse Better Than an Apple Trackpad!
repos.summary_zh: Mac Mouse Fix 是一款 macOS 系统增强工具，通过强大的手势识别与按键自定义功能，将普通鼠标的体验提升至超越 Apple 触控板的水平。它支持平滑滚动、应用切换等高级手势，并兼容罗技等主流鼠标，提供媲美原生触控板的流畅交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Mac Mouse Fix is a macOS utility that enhances any mouse with advanced gestures and customizable buttons, delivering a user experience surpassing Apple Trackpads. It enables smooth scrolling, app switching, and intuitive controls, making budget mice as efficient as premium trackpads or Logitech MX Master.

repos.description: A lightweight screen recorder based on ScreenCapture Kit for macOS / 基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量化多功能 macOS 录屏工具
repos.summary_zh: QuickRecorder 是一款基于 ScreenCapture Kit 的轻量级高性能 macOS 录屏工具，支持屏幕、窗口、应用及移动设备录制。具备免驱音频回环、鼠标高亮、屏幕放大镜等功能，并完整支持 macOS 14 的 Presenter Overlay 实时摄像头叠加，以及 HEVC with Alpha 格式输出（含透明通道），适用于专业视频制作与会议录制。
repos.summary_en: QuickRecorder is a lightweight, high-performance screen recorder for macOS built on ScreenCapture Kit. It supports recording screens, windows, apps, and mobile devices with features like driver-free audio loopback, mouse highlighting, and screen magnifier. It fully supports macOS 14's Presenter Overlay for real-time camera overlay and HEVC with Alpha output (with alpha channel), ideal for professional video editing and conferencing.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是一款轻量跨平台本地网关工具，统一管理多种 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）的模型选择与 API 路由。通过菜单栏应用、TUI 和 CLI 三种形态，无缝切换模型、共享订阅、自动同步实时模型目录，并精确编辑配置文件，实现多代理一站式编排。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a lightweight cross-platform local gateway that centrally manages model selection and API routing for multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). It offers menu-bar GUI, TUI and CLI interfaces, supports shared subscriptions, real-time model discovery, and surgical config editing for unified multi-agent orchestration.

repos.description: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS
repos.summary_zh: ClashMac 是一款专为 macOS 打造的本地代理客户端，采用 SwiftUI 原生开发，深度集成系统。提供航线地图、连接拓扑和流量统计三大核心可视化功能，支持系统代理与 TUN 增强模式，具备菜单栏常驻、隐私模式、实时切换和自动重连等特性，带来直观高效的代理管理体验。
repos.summary_en: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client built with SwiftUI, offering route map visualization, connection topology, and real-time traffic statistics. It supports system proxy and TUN modes, features menu bar integration, privacy mode, instant node switching, and auto-reconnection for an intuitive proxy management experience.

repos.description: Free and open source database client built natively for developers
repos.summary_zh: TablePro 是一款面向开发者的免费开源原生数据库客户端，支持 macOS、iOS 和 Linux。它摒弃 Electron 和 JVM，采用原生框架构建，冷启动低于 1 秒，内存占用约 80MB。支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis 等主流 SQL/NoSQL 数据库，内置 AI 功能（聊天、代码建议、MCP 服务），并可通过插件扩展。提供 SQL 编辑器、数据网格、SSH 隧道、iCloud 同步等核心功能，是 TablePlus 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: TablePro is a free, open-source native database client for developers, built without Electron or JVM. It supports major SQL and NoSQL databases with native drivers, cold starts under 1 second, and ~80MB RAM usage. Features include an AI-powered SQL editor, data grid, SSH tunnels, iCloud sync, and plugin extensibility. It serves as an open-source alternative to TablePlus with integrated AI chat, MCP server, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: 🎃 A blazing-fast Mac terminal, built for coding with AI.
repos.summary_zh: Kaku 是一款专为 AI 编程优化的终端模拟器，基于 WezTerm 深度定制。它提供开箱即用的体验，支持零配置启动、主题自适应切换、内置 zsh 插件及轻量级高性能内核，并集成 AI 助手用于命令行错误修复与智能编码辅助。
repos.summary_en: Kaku is a high-performance terminal emulator built for AI coding, forked from WezTerm with deep customizations. It offers zero-config setup, theme-aware UI, integrated shell tools, and a built-in AI assistant for command recovery and coding support.

repos.description: Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
repos.summary_zh: Lunar 是一款专为 macOS 设计的显示器控制应用，支持通过 DDC/CI 协议直接调节外接显示器亮度、音量、输入源及屏幕方向。其核心亮点包括传感器/同步/位置自适应亮度调节、XDR/HDR 高亮度支持、低于 0% 的暗光模式、App 预设配置及 BlackOut 功能（关闭屏幕同时保留充电、音频等功能），完美兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片。
repos.summary_en: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors via DDC/CI, enabling hardware-level brightness, volume, input switching, and orientation adjustments. Key features include sensor/sync/location-based adaptive brightness, support for 1000–1600 nits XDR/HDR displays, sub-zero dimming, app-specific presets, and BlackOut mode—preserving charging, audio, and input while turning off screens. Fully compatible with both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.

repos.description: Enable Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China with SIP enabled, for version between  MacOS 15.4.1+ and 26.5 beta3
repos.summary_zh: 本工具通过修改系统缓存文件及注入eligibiltyd进程，绕过Apple对Apple Intelligence在中国销售Mac上的区域限制，支持macOS 15.4+及26.1+，无需常驻后台服务。提供方法1（lldb注入+文件锁定）和方法2（直接修改plist）两种方案，新增强制修改地区为美国功能以解锁ChatGPT整合等高级特性，适用于M1及以上芯片设备。
repos.summary_en: This tool enables Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China by bypassing regional restrictions via system cache modification and eligibilityd process injection, tested on macOS 15.4+ and 26.1+. It requires no persistent background services and offers two methods: Method 1 (lldb injection + file locking) and Method 2 (direct plist editing), with an added option to force region change to US for advanced features like ChatGPT integration, compatible with M1+ chips.

repos.description: An unofficial bilibili client for mac
repos.summary_zh: Bilibili Mac Client 是一款非官方哔哩哔哩桌面客户端，基于 mpv 实现硬解播放与 libass 弹幕渲染，支持多视频网站解析、分段视频拼接、弹幕发送与屏蔽、本地视频播放及自定义配置，显著降低 CPU 占用并优化能效表现。
repos.summary_en: An unofficial Bilibili desktop client for macOS, built on mpv with hardware decoding and libass-based danmaku rendering. It supports multi-site video parsing, segmented video stitching, danmaku interaction, local playback, and extensive customization via mpv config, offering superior performance and energy efficiency compared to HTML5 players.

repos.description: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)
repos.summary_zh: OpenLess 是一款开源的跨平台语音输入工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows。用户按住快捷键说话，松开后即可获得 AI 润色后的文本，并自动插入光标位置或复制到剪贴板。其核心亮点是 AI 提示模式，能将口语化表达转化为结构清晰、上下文丰富的提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具，提升输入效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Press a hotkey, speak naturally, and get AI-polished text inserted at your cursor or copied to clipboard. Its standout feature is AI-prompt mode, which transforms rambling speech into structured, context-rich prompts ready for use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

repos.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
repos.summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
repos.summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

repos.description: An unofficial 12306 Client for Mac
repos.summary_zh: 12306ForMac 是一款非官方的 Mac 版 12306 火车票订票助手，支持自动捡票与下单功能。基于 Swift 开发，依赖 Carthage 管理 CocoaPods 依赖，兼容 OS X 10.11 及以上系统。项目采用 Alamofire、PromiseKit 等主流框架，提供图形化界面替代官方网页购票，适用于 macOS 用户便捷购票。
repos.summary_en: 12306ForMac is an unofficial macOS client for 12306 railway ticket booking, supporting auto-search and purchasing. Built with Swift 3.2 and Xcode 9.0, it uses Carthage for dependency management and integrates Alamofire, PromiseKit, and FMDB. Designed for OS X 10.11+, it offers a native GUI alternative to the official web interface for convenient ticket booking.

repos.description: A command line tool for upgrading every outdated app installed by Homebrew Cask
repos.summary_zh: brew-cask-upgrade 是一个命令行工具，用于升级通过 Homebrew Cask 安装的过时 macOS GUI 应用。它提供交互式界面、细粒度控制及自动更新检测，支持批量升级、排除自动更新应用、清理缓存等功能，是 Homebrew Cask 生态中提升应用管理效率的关键工具。
repos.summary_en: brew-cask-upgrade is a CLI tool to upgrade outdated macOS GUI apps installed via Homebrew Cask. It offers interactive prompts, granular control, auto-update detection, batch upgrades, and features like cleanup and quarantine bypass, enhancing the efficiency of managing Homebrew Cask applications.

repos.description: 📺 Homebrew's official macOS GUI
repos.summary_zh: Homebrew官方macOS图形界面应用，采用SwiftUI构建，为不熟悉终端的用户提供直观的包管理体验。通过透明展示底层brew操作，实现软件包的安全发现、安装、更新与管理，适用于追求现代化原生体验的macOS开发者与普通用户。
repos.summary_en: Homebrew's official macOS GUI built with SwiftUI, offering an intuitive package management experience for users who prefer graphical interfaces over terminal. It transparently exposes underlying brew operations while enabling safe discovery, installation, and update of packages through a native macOS application.

repos.description: Magic auto brightness based on screen contents 💡
repos.summary_zh: Lumen 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，能根据屏幕内容自动调节亮度。用户只需使用亮度键即可控制，系统会自动学习偏好。当屏幕显示深色内容（如终端）时自动调亮，显示浅色内容（如网页）时自动调暗，显著提升夜间使用舒适度，尤其适合长时间编程或阅读。
repos.summary_en: Lumen is a macOS menu bar app that automatically adjusts screen brightness based on displayed content. It learns user preferences via brightness keys, brightening the screen for dark content (e.g., terminal) and dimming it for light content (e.g., web pages), offering a more comfortable viewing experience, especially at night.

repos.summary_zh: Yetone语音输入是一款macOS菜单栏语音输入应用，支持按住Fn键录音、实时流式语音识别（Apple Speech框架），自动注入文本到当前焦点输入框。具备CJK输入法兼容处理、多语言切换、动态波形动画浮窗、LLM后处理纠错等功能，采用Swift开发，提供Makefile构建脚本。
repos.summary_en: Yetone Voice Input is a macOS menu-bar app enabling voice input via Fn key hold/release. It features real-time streaming speech recognition (Apple Speech), text injection with CJK IME compatibility, animated waveform floating window, multi-language support, and optional LLM-based transcription refinement via OpenAI-compatible API.

repos.description: A beautiful screenshot + screen recording + Loom alternative - all native, self hostable and free.
repos.summary_zh: Screendrop 是一款 macOS 原生免费开源的截图与屏幕录制工具，作为 Loom 的自托管替代方案。支持全屏/窗口/区域捕获、视频转录、字幕生成、画中画剪辑，并通过 Cloudflare 实现带搜索与评论功能的链接分享，深度集成 Apple Shortcuts 与 Siri 自动化。
repos.summary_en: Screendrop is a free, native macOS screenshot and screen recording app — an open-source, self-hostable Loom alternative. Features include AI on-device transcription, karaoke captions, video editing with zooms and picture-in-picture, smart redaction, and shareable links with searchable transcripts and comments via Cloudflare. Integrates with Apple Shortcuts, Siri, and Finder for seamless automation.

repos.description: 📦 A macOS utility to seamlessly migrate applications to external storage and reclaim local disk space.【一款 macOS 工具，无缝迁移应用到外部存储并自动建立链接，释放宝贵的本地空间】
repos.summary_zh: AppPorts 是一款专为 macOS 设计的应用迁移工具，可将大型应用一键移至外部存储（SSD/SD卡/NAS），并在原位保留极小的启动桩，实现无快捷箭头、无缝启动。具备自动更新保护、代码签名修复、孤立链接检测及数据目录迁移功能，有效解决 Mac 本地空间不足问题。
repos.summary_en: AppPorts is a macOS utility for seamlessly migrating large applications to external storage (SSD/SD card/NAS) while leaving a tiny launcher stub locally. It features arrow-free linking, auto-update protection, code signature repair, and orphaned link detection, effectively reclaiming precious local disk space without breaking system integration.

repos.description: Every display control macOS hides, in one menu bar app: sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness and volume, Extra Brightness past 100%, presets, virtual displays. Free and open source, a no-cost alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar.
repos.summary_zh: Crisp是免费开源的macOS外接显示器控制面板，提供锐利HiDPI缩放、DDC亮度调节、显示器预设与虚拟屏幕等功能，替代BetterDisplay等付费工具，提升多屏显示体验。
repos.summary_en: Crisp is a free, open-source external monitor control app for macOS, offering sharp HiDPI scaling, DDC brightness control, display presets and virtual displays as an alternative to paid tools like BetterDisplay.

repos.description: Your AI agent skills, finally organized. A macOS app to browse, edit, and manage skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Amp.
repos.summary_zh: Chops 是一款 macOS 原生应用，专为统一管理和编辑 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf、Amp 等 AI 编程工具的代码技能而设计。支持实时文件监控、全文搜索、集合分类和远程技能库连接，提供 SwiftUI + SwiftData 架构下的流畅编辑体验。
repos.summary_en: Chops is a native macOS app that centralizes management of AI coding agent skills across tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It features real-time file watching, full-text search, collections, and remote skill server integration, built with SwiftUI and SwiftData for seamless editing.

repos.description: 无线麦（SayAll.app）：支持小米蓝牙遥控器 2 和 2 Pro，变成 Mac 语音输入设备
repos.summary_zh: 无线麦 SayAll 是一款 macOS 原生应用，可将小米蓝牙遥控器 2 Pro 转化为 Mac 语音输入设备，支持按住说话实时输入、多套键位方案按 App 自动切换，以及组合动作自动化流程，内置记录回眸与 MCP 本地 Agent 集成，CPU 占用低于 0.5%，内存约 50MB，兼顾轻量与高效。
repos.summary_en: SayAll is a native macOS app that transforms Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 Pro into a wireless microphone for Mac, enabling real-time voice typing, per-app shortcut profiles, and automation workflows. It features voice history logging with local MCP agent integration, runs lightweight under 0.5% CPU and ~50MB memory.

repos.description: Google Assistant for macOS!
repos.summary_zh: MacAssistant 是一款将 Google Assistant 集成到 macOS 的 Swift 应用，支持语音交互与系统控制。通过 Google Assistant SDK 实现自然语言处理，支持天气查询、日程管理等常见指令，需用户自行配置 OAuth 凭证。项目采用 Swift 4.2 开发，基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers，提供跨平台语音助手解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MacAssistant is a Swift-based macOS app integrating Google Assistant via the Google Assistant SDK, enabling voice interaction and system control. It supports natural language queries like weather and agenda, requiring user-provided OAuth credentials. Built with Swift 4.2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers, it offers a cross-platform voice assistant solution for macOS.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

repos.description: 原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，基于 SwiftUI + AppKit，由 mihomo 驱动。 轻量、稳定，在菜单栏完成配置、节点、规则、连接与系统代理管理。
repos.summary_zh: ClashBar 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏代理客户端，基于 mihomo Core，采用 SwiftUI + AppKit 构建。主打轻量化设计（37.5MB），支持配置管理、节点切换、流量策略控制、实时连接监控与系统代理集成，提供中英文双语界面，专注提升代理工具在 macOS 上的易用性与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: ClashBar is a native macOS menu bar proxy client built with SwiftUI + AppKit, powered by mihomo Core. It emphasizes lightweight design (37.5MB), offering configuration management, node switching, traffic policy control, real-time connection monitoring, and system proxy integration. With bilingual support (zh/en), it enhances usability and stability for proxy tools on macOS.

repos.description: Native GUI for Homebrew Casks
repos.summary_zh: CaskHub 是 Homebrew Casks 的原生 macOS 图形界面应用，支持浏览、搜索、安装、更新和卸载 Mac 应用。采用 SwiftUI 构建，提供分类导航、排行榜、一键 Adopt 非 Homebrew 应用等功能，完全免费开源，无广告订阅。
repos.summary_en: CaskHub is a native macOS GUI for Homebrew Casks, enabling browsing, searching, installing, updating, and uninstalling Mac apps. Built with SwiftUI, it features category browsing, popularity charts, one-click app adoption, and is 100% free and open source with no ads or subscriptions.

repos.description: A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
repos.summary_zh: MacTools 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS 菜单栏工具集，提供系统状态监控、活动统计、快捷控制（显示/音频/电源）等插件面板。支持自定义组件排列、多主题切换（兼容 iTerm2/Base16）及插件市场扩展，界面深度适配 macOS 原生风格，基于 SwiftUI 构建，要求 macOS 14+
repos.summary_en: MacTools is a free, open-source native macOS menu bar toolkit offering system status widgets, activity analytics, and quick controls for display, audio, and power. It features a plugin marketplace, draggable custom panels, light/dark theme support (including iTerm2 and Base16 palettes), and a polished SwiftUI-based interface requiring macOS 14+.

repos.description: A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
repos.summary_zh: MacTools 是一款基于 SwiftUI 和 AppKit 开发的免费开源 macOS 菜单栏工具集，专为 macOS 14.0+ 设计。它集成了显示器亮度调节、分辨率切换、深色模式、夜览、防睡眠、鼠标增强、隐藏刘海、磁盘清理及 Xcode 缓存清理等数十项高频系统操作，旨在通过轻量、无干扰的原生应用提升 Mac 用户的工作效率与系统管理能力。
repos.summary_en: MacTools is a free, open-source collection of native macOS menu bar utilities built with SwiftUI and AppKit for macOS 14.0+. It consolidates dozens of high-frequency system actions—including display brightness/resolution control, Dark Mode, Night Shift, sleep prevention, mouse enhancement, notch hiding, disk cleanup, and Xcode cache management—into a lightweight, unobtrusive app to boost productivity and system control.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

repos.description: 文颜- Markdown文章排版美化工具，支持微信公众号、今日头条、知乎等平台。
repos.summary_zh: 文颜是一款专为 Markdown 内容创作者设计的排版美化工具，支持一键将 Markdown 文章转换为适配微信公众号、知乎、今日头条等主流平台的富文本格式，内置多款 Typora 主题并支持自定义样式，自动处理图片上传与数学公式渲染，让写作者专注于内容创作而非繁琐排版。
repos.summary_en: Wenyan is a Markdown formatting and publishing tool designed for content creators, enabling one-click conversion of Markdown articles into platform-specific rich text formats for WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Toutiao, and more. It features built-in Typora themes, custom styling, automatic image uploads, MathJax support, and seamless cross-platform publishing.

repos.description: This is a Opensource Live wallpaper solution for MacOS
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为 macOS 14+ 设计的开源动态壁纸应用，支持 MP4 和 MOV 视频格式，具备多显示器支持与高性能渲染。用户可通过 Homebrew 或源码编译安装，需注意绕过 Gatekeeper 安全限制。项目计划将 Objective-C++ UI 迁移至 SwiftUI，但守护进程保持不变。
repos.summary_en: An open-source live wallpaper app for macOS 14+, supporting MP4/MOV video playback with multi-display rendering and high performance. Install via Homebrew or compile from source using Xcode and CMake. Requires Gatekeeper bypass for unsigned apps. UI modernization to SwiftUI is planned while maintaining the daemon component.

repos.description: 🎙️ An intelligent voice productivity assistant that turns speech into clean text, useful actions, and structured knowledge. It helps users capture ideas, communicate naturally, automate repetitive tasks, and stay productive across different apps and workflows.
repos.summary_zh: Voxt 是一款专为 macOS 设计的语音输入与翻译应用，支持全局热键录音、实时波形显示、多引擎语音识别（本地 MLX 和远程 ASR 服务）及文本增强翻译，具备剪贴板安全粘贴、历史记录管理和多模式触发机制，适用于跨语言实时转录与翻译场景。
repos.summary_en: Voxt is a macOS menu bar app for voice input and translation, featuring global hotkey recording, real-time waveform display, multi-engine speech recognition (local MLX and remote ASR), text enhancement, and clipboard-safe auto-paste. It supports transcription, translation, selected-text processing, and history management with configurable providers.

repos.description: A calm menu bar, done the native way. Hides the icons you don't need until you do.
repos.summary_zh: Pelmet 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，专为 macOS 27 重新设计的菜单栏打造。它可将不常用图标自动隐藏，通过悬停、点击或快捷键优雅恢复显示，支持可视化布局编辑器与三区域分组管理，免费开源无账号要求。
repos.summary_en: Pelmet is an open-source macOS menu bar manager designed for the redesigned menu bar in macOS 27. It auto-hides unused icons and elegantly reveals them via hover, click, or shortcuts, featuring a visual layout editor with three-zone grouping. Free, native, no account needed.

repos.description: Master your Mac’s ⌘Tab
repos.summary_zh: BetterCmdTab 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 ⌘+Tab 应用切换器增强工具，提供列表、网格和实时预览三种布局，支持模糊搜索、窗口平铺、标签页切换及多显示器操作。采用原生 SwiftUI 开发，具备 Liquid Glass 视觉效果，无遥测且完全免费，极大提升 Mac 用户的窗口管理效率。
repos.summary_en: BetterCmdTab enhances the macOS ⌘+Tab experience with three layouts (list, grid, live preview), fuzzy search, window tiling, and tab switching. Built natively with SwiftUI featuring Liquid Glass aesthetics, it offers zero telemetry and is free forever, significantly boosting window management efficiency for Mac users.

repos.description: Clash X
repos.summary_zh: ClashX 是一款基于 Clash 的 macOS 代理客户端，专为 macOS 15+ (Sequoia) 优化，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、SOCKS 协议及 Vmess/Shadowsocks/Trojan 等多种代理协议。提供直观的图形界面与 Surge 风格配置，集成 GeoIP 规则、Netfilter TCP 重定向等功能，适用于高级网络代理需求。
repos.summary_en: ClashX is a rule-based proxy client for macOS built on Clash, optimized for macOS 15+ (Sequoia). It supports HTTP/HTTPS, SOCKS protocols and multiple proxy types including Vmess, Shadowsocks, and Trojan. Features intuitive UI, Surge-like configuration, GeoIP rules, Netfilter TCP redirection, and advanced scripting capabilities.

repos.description: Open-source cross-platform software KVM for sharing keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux on trusted LANs.
repos.summary_zh: MyKVM 是一款开源的跨平台软件 KVM 解决方案，允许用户通过局域网在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 设备间无缝共享键盘、鼠标和剪贴板。它利用 QUIC/TLS 加密传输输入与剪贴板数据，支持自动发现与多显示器布局，旨在替代传统硬件 KVM 切换器，为多机工作者提供零线缆的流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: MyKVM is an open-source, cross-platform software KVM that enables seamless sharing of keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices over a trusted LAN. Utilizing encrypted QUIC/TLS for input and clipboard data transfer, it features automatic peer discovery and multi-monitor layout support, aiming to replace traditional hardware KVM switches with a zero-cable experience for multi-machine workflows.

repos.description: A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.
repos.summary_zh: kooky 是一款专为 AI 编码打造的现代化 macOS 终端模拟器，基于 libghostty 实现 GPU 渲染。核心特性包括侧边栏工作区、多窗格分屏、一键启动 Claude Code/Gemini CLI 等多种 AI Agent、Git Worktree 隔离开发、右键选中内容直接询问 Agent、模糊快速打开面板以及多行提示词编辑器。支持会话自动恢复、跨窗口拖拽标签页，无账号无遥测，状态完全本地存储。
repos.summary_en: kooky is a minimal modern terminal emulator built for AI coding on macOS, powered by libghostty with GPU rendering. Key features include sidebar workspaces, horizontal/vertical split panes, one-click launch of Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other AI agents, Git Worktree isolation, right-click-to-ask-agent on selections, fuzzy Quick Open panel, and a multi-line prompt composer. Sessions auto-resume across restarts, tabs are draggable across panes and windows, and all state stays local with no accounts or telemetry.

repos.description: Beautiful native macOS download manager for direct links, magnets, and torrents.
repos.summary_zh: Harbor是一款原生macOS下载管理器，基于SwiftUI构建，支持直链、磁力链接与种子文件下载。主打本地优先、隐私友好设计，提供批量添加、流量控制、Torrent预览等实用功能，完美契合Mac原生工作流。
repos.summary_en: Harbor is a beautiful native macOS download manager built with SwiftUI, supporting direct links, magnet links, and torrents. Local-first, privacy-friendly, and free, it offers batch queuing, traffic profiles, and Torrent preview for a seamless Mac-native experience.

repos.description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
repos.summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

repos.description: A native macOS menu-bar app that keeps your keyboard input source locked — global, per-app, and per-URL.
repos.summary_zh: LockIME 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，专注于解决多输入法切换混乱问题。它支持全局、按应用及按浏览器 URL 锁定键盘输入源，一旦检测到输入法被切换，立即自动恢复。基于 Swift 6 和 Liquid Glass 技术构建，提供灵活的规则匹配与快捷键控制，显著提升多语言用户的输入效率。
repos.summary_en: LockIME is a native macOS menu-bar utility that locks your keyboard input source globally, per-app, or per-URL. It instantly reverts any unauthorized input method switches, ensuring a consistent typing experience. Built with Swift 6 and Liquid Glass, it offers flexible rule matching and global shortcuts for power users.

repos.description: A keyboard-driven window switcher for macOS. Notarized. Free.
repos.summary_zh: Switch 是一款专为 macOS 设计的免费键盘驱动窗口切换器。它支持跨空间窗口管理、垂直列表视图及粘性模式，提供类似 Spotlight 的即时过滤与数字快捷键选择，彻底替代原生 ⌘Tab，大幅提升多窗口操作效率。
repos.summary_en: Switch is a free, keyboard-driven window switcher for macOS. It replaces the native ⌘Tab with instant filtering, cross-space management, and sticky mode, allowing users to quickly navigate and manage windows using only the keyboard.

repos.description: 使用任何设备(浏览器)作为mac的副屏(随航) 将Android平板用作Mac的第二台显示器 还能在Win和Linux镜像屏幕
repos.summary_zh: 咩Display 是一款跨平台屏幕镜像工具，支持将任意带浏览器的设备（如 Android 平板）作为 Mac 的副屏，实现类似 Apple 随航的功能。基于 ffmpeg 实时转码，支持 mjpg、vp8、h264、hevc 多种编码，延迟低至 100ms（mjpg 模式），适用于 Windows/Linux 屏幕镜像。内置自动旋转、全屏切换，支持通过 ADB 实现 Android 有线连接，适合多屏办公与移动场景。
repos.summary_en: meDisplay is a cross-platform screen mirroring tool that turns any browser-equipped device (e.g., Android tablet) into a secondary display for Mac, mimicking Apple's Sidecar. Built with real-time ffmpeg transcoding, it supports mjpg, vp8, h264, and hevc encoding with ultra-low latency (as low as 100ms in mjpg mode). Also supports Windows/Linux X11 mirroring, auto-rotation, fullscreen toggle, and ADB-based Android wired connection for seamless multi-screen workflows.

repos.description: Beans Music - iOS 26 液态玻璃风格第三方音乐播放器（仅供学习）
repos.summary_zh: 基于 SwiftUI 构建的 iOS 第三方音乐播放器，采用 iOS 26 液态玻璃设计语言，聚合网易云音乐与 QQ 音乐双平台数据。支持歌词深度定制、动态封面取色、自由布局调整及一键备份，提供沉浸式本地化体验。
repos.summary_en: A SwiftUI-based third-party iOS music player featuring iOS 26 Liquid Glass design. Aggregates NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music with deep lyric customization, dynamic cover color extraction, free layout adjustment, and one-click backup for an immersive localized experience.

repos.description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks your dev servers across projects.
repos.summary_zh: Port Menu 是一款轻量级 macOS 菜单栏应用，专为开发者设计，用于自动追踪跨项目的本地开发服务器。它能实时扫描并展示 Git 仓库名、分支、端口及运行时长，支持一键打开浏览器、复制 URL 或终止进程，无需任何配置即可实现 localhost 服务的可视化管理。
repos.summary_en: Port Menu is a lightweight macOS menu bar app designed for developers to automatically track local development servers across projects. It scans running processes to display Git repo names, branches, ports, and uptime. With zero configuration, it enables one-click access to open in browser, copy URLs, or kill processes directly from the menu bar.

repos.description: A native macOS workspace terminal organized around Projects and Worktrees, powered by tmux and libghostty
repos.summary_zh: Mori 是一款专为 macOS 设计的原生终端工作空间管理工具，围绕 Git 项目的 Worktree 构建，通过 tmux 实现持久化会话管理，并集成 libghostty 提供 GPU 加速的终端渲染。支持本地与远程仓库、项目级导航、独立分支会话及 SwiftUI 侧边栏交互，提供类 IDE 的高效开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Mori is a native macOS terminal workspace manager centered on Projects and Git Worktrees, powered by tmux for persistent sessions and libghostty for GPU-accelerated terminal rendering. It enables project-first navigation, local/remote repo support, independent branch sessions, and a SwiftUI sidebar interface, delivering an IDE-like development workflow.

repos.description: A declarative, SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in Swift.
repos.summary_zh: TUIkit 是一个 SwiftUI 风格的终端用户界面框架，提供纯 Swift 实现的声明式 TUI 开发体验。支持状态管理、布局容器、交互组件和完整样式系统，无需 ncurses 或 C 依赖，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: TUIkit is a SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in pure Swift, offering declarative syntax with state management, layout containers, interactive components, and full styling support without ncurses or C dependencies.

repos.description: ClashFX — macOS proxy tool with Enhanced Mode (TUN)
repos.summary_zh: ClashFX 是一款基于 mihomo 核心的 macOS 代理工具，支持 TUN 模式实现全局流量捕获，提供规则路由、多协议代理（VMess/VLESS/Trojan 等）、DNS 安全及 Apple Silicon 原生支持，适用于高级网络代理与隐私保护场景。
repos.summary_en: ClashFX is a macOS proxy client powered by the mihomo core, featuring TUN-based Enhanced Mode for system-wide traffic capture, rule-based routing, support for multiple protocols (VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks/Hysteria2), secure DNS with Fake-IP, and native Apple Silicon compatibility.

repos.description: A free macOS native app to remove image backgrounds locally
repos.summary_zh: Figura 是一款免费的 macOS 原生应用，利用系统 Vision 框架实现本地快速背景去除，支持拖拽、粘贴或点击上传，界面简洁现代，兼容深色/浅色模式，专为 macOS 14+ 设计。
repos.summary_en: Figura is a free native macOS app that leverages the system's Vision framework for fast, local background removal. It supports drag-and-drop, paste (⌘V), or click upload, features a minimalist SwiftUI interface, and works on macOS 14+ with dark/light mode support.

repos.description: A lightweight, context-aware AI assistant designed specifically for macOS
repos.summary_zh: Sidey 是一款专为 macOS 打造的轻量级、上下文感知 AI 助手。它以菜单栏弹出窗口和悬浮窗伴侣形式快速调用，支持选中文本即时处理、应用感知提示词推荐、多应用专属 AI 人格自动创建，并深度集成 Safari 与 Finder。内置公共 AI 服务无需 API Key，支持 Markdown 渲染、iCloud 同步与全局热键，实现无缝跨应用智能辅助。
repos.summary_en: Sidey is a lightweight, context-aware AI assistant built exclusively for macOS. It launches instantly from the menu bar or as a window-docked companion, offering selection-based text processing, app-aware prompt suggestions, and auto-generated AI personas per application. With deep Safari and Finder integration, built-in public AI service, Markdown rendering, iCloud sync, and global hotkeys, Sidey delivers seamless cross-app intelligent assistance without disrupting your workflow.

repos.description: Awesome open-source macOS applications
repos.summary_zh: 自动聚合GitHub星标仓库，构建macOS开源应用 browsable 目录。收录281款应用，涵盖AI大模型、开发者工具、系统维护等26个分类，每日自动同步更新，提供免手工维护的macOS生态发现入口。
repos.summary_en: An auto-generated browser curating 281 macOS open-source apps from GitHub stars across 26 categories. Covers AI/LLM, developer tools, productivity, and system utilities. Synced daily with zero manual editing — a hands-off discovery hub for the macOS ecosystem.
